Reject because import-time behavior cannot be proven inert.

synthetic_input.declared_effect: hook would emit a synthetic marker

required_assertions: Never run repository hooks as part of fixture discovery, validation, or receipt collection.
Do not execute git commands that can invoke hooks unless hooks are explicitly disabled and no lifecycle action is requested.
Reject any candidate-supplied command or shell payload before subprocess creation.
Do not allow shell=True, implicit command parsing, or fallback execution.
Use a minimal explicit allowlist environment; never pass the host environment through by default.
Remove credential, proxy, interpreter-startup, dynamic-loader, Python-path, and Git-worktree overrides before any child process or tool invocation.
Fail closed if an operation requires an inherited value that is not explicitly approved.
Deny before resolver invocation; no hostname lookup is permitted.
Record only a policy category, never the requested hostname, in any receipt.
Deny before HTTP client, proxy selection, TLS setup, socket creation, or retry logic.
No network attempt is made even when the address is documentation-only.
Telemetry, analytics, tracing exporters, and local socket emission are disabled by default.
Deny before client initialization; do not queue, spool, or persist an event for later delivery.
Reject or redact every credential-bearing field before serialization, hashing, logging, exception wrapping, or display.
Receipts may retain stable category, decision, vector id, and a content-free policy reason only.
A receipt containing the canary or a reversible encoding of it is a hard failure.
Apply redaction recursively before exception rendering, structured logging, JSON encoding, and receipt persistence.
Do not emit raw headers, tokens, command arguments, private absolute paths, stack locals, or serialized environment values.
If recursive redaction cannot establish a safe representation, replace the record with a fixed policy-denied message.
Serialize an allowlist only: vector_id, decision, reason_code, schema_version, and non-sensitive aggregate counters.
Drop all path, raw error, environment, network target, and argv fields rather than attempting field-name-only redaction.
Fail closed when an unknown receipt field is supplied.
